Avi Levin as chief financial officer, effective October 1, 2026.
Levin succeeds Shlomo Zakai, who is expected to remain with the company as a financial and corporate consultant during the transition.

Levin brings more than 20 years of corporate finance and capital-markets experience across the U.S. and Israel. He has helped raise more than $130M through private placements and public offerings with Nasdaq-listed companies.
